soldier.name: SOLDIER
soldier.title: Man-at-Arms
taunts: Steel doesn't care for your sparks.
soldier.desc: Solid HP and a good sword. Shield Wall: while he Guards, his shield also halves a spell aimed at him.

archer.name: ARCHER
archer.title: Bowman
archer.desc: Fragile, with a weaker shot. At Range: his arrows slip past a Guard (no block, no counter), and he keeps his distance, so a Grapple can't reach him.

halberdier.name: HALBERDIER
halberdier.title: Halberdier
halberdier.desc: Hits hard with a long-hafted axe. Long Reach: he holds you off at the end of his polearm, so a Grapple at him fails.

knight.name: KNIGHT
knight.title: Knight of the Order
knight.desc: Plate armour and a long sword: more HP and a harder blow than a soldier. Shield Wall: while he Guards, his shield also halves a spell aimed at him.

echo_fire_weak.name: EMBER APPRENTICE
echo_fire_weak.title: A forge apprentice of living flame
taunts: (it does not see you; it sees the street as it was)
echo_fire_weak.desc: An Echo of Corvanthe, remade in fire. Its blow is a fire strike (a ward stops it); it shrugs off fire and its opposite tears it apart.

boxer_tolley.name: TWO-STEP TOLLEY
boxer_tolley.title: Boxer
boxer_tolley.desc: A quick little man, light on his toes. Like most boxers, a creature of habit.

boxer_meg.name: MIRROR MEG
boxer_meg.title: Boxer
boxer_meg.desc: Lean and watchful. Somehow she always seems to know what you've just done.

boxer_horace.name: HORACE “THE CLINCH” WEBB
boxer_horace.title: Boxer
boxer_horace.desc: A huge, patient grappler. He waits for his moment.

boxer_jem.name: GENTLEMAN JEM
boxer_jem.title: Champion of the Fancy
boxer_jem.desc: The Champion: elegant, orderly, never rattled. Until he is.
